content.text: In Tanzania, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-what-actually-how-2|digital]] creators face a critical barrier: global payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal are either unavailable or severely restricted. This isn’t a minor inconvenience—it’s a full stop on your ability to sell globally. If you’re [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-courses-pakistan-without-stripe-honest-side-side-3|Selling Courses]] ebooks, courses, or templates, your revenue stream is locked out before it begins. This guide solves that problem with sovereign commerce infrastructure. You’ll deploy a stack that owns its payment pipeline, delivery mechanism, and data storage. No platform dependencies. No subscriptions. Just infrastructure you control, built on Cloudflare and blockchain payments. This isn’t a workaround—it’s a permanent solution. By the end of this guide, you’ll have a fully operational online store that processes [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-broken-here-infrastructure|COREMERCH guide to crypto]] payments automatically, delivers products instantly, and stores your data securely. No Stripe required. No geographic barriers. Just commerce sovereignty.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Selling Digital Products from Africa: The Complete Infrastructure Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-africa-step-step-deployment-guide. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Global payment platforms fail creators in Tanzania for one reason: they’re not built for your geography. Stripe and PayPal require banking systems they trust, currencies they support, and regulatory environments they understand. Tanzania doesn’t meet those criteria—so you’re excluded. This infrastructure bypasses that exclusion by using tools that don’t care about your location. Cloudflare Pages hosts your store for free, with global CDN distribution. Cloudflare Workers handles backend logic without servers. Supabase stores orders securely, and NOWPayments processes crypto transactions on-chain. The key is decentralization. Crypto payments don’t rely on banks or platforms. They rely on blockchain networks—which are borderless. When a customer pays in USDT on TRON, the transaction confirms in seconds for under $0.10. No middlemen. No rejections. Your store operates on infrastructure you own, not rent. This isn’t a temporary fix—it’s a permanent shift to sovereignty.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying, gather three critical components. First, a domain name. Buy one from Namecheap or use a free Cloudflare subdomain. This is your store’s address. Second, a NOWPayments account. Sign up at nowpayments.io—no KYC required. This is your payment gateway. Third, your digital products. Organize them in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. These are the assets you’ll sell. You’ll also need a GitHub or Cloudflare account for deployment. No coding required—the Complete Builder Kit provides templates. If you’re using the Sovereign Starter Stack, GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script will handle hosting and logic. For the Edge Commerce Stack, Cloudflare Pages and Workers provide faster performance. Ensure your products are formatted for instant delivery—PDFs, ZIP files, or download links. Test each file to confirm it opens correctly. This preparation ensures deployment is seamless. You’re not building from scratch—you’re assembling proven components into a stack you own.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start with payment integration. Log into NOWPayments, create an API key, and select your preferred cryptocurrency—USDT on TRON for low fees. Configure the webhook to trigger product delivery once payment confirms. Next, set up file delivery. Upload your products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Generate shareable links for each file. In your backend logic (Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Worker), write a function that sends these links to customers after payment. For order storage, use Supabase or Google Sheets. Supabase is more robust, while Google Sheets is simpler. Both store customer data securely. Connect your backend to this database to log each transaction. Test the pipeline before going live. Send a test payment, ensure the webhook fires, and confirm the product delivers instantly. This pipeline is your store’s backbone—automating payments, delivery, and data storage without manual intervention.
Crypto payments remove geographic barriers—sell globally without platform restrictions.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your store to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Both platforms offer free hosting with global CDN distribution. Connect your domain and push your code. Once live, test the entire flow. Visit your store, purchase a product using crypto, and confirm the delivery email arrives instantly. Monitor the transaction in NOWPayments and your order database. If everything works, your store is operational. Share the link with your audience. For your first real transaction, communicate clearly with the buyer. Explain that payment is processed on-chain and delivery is instant. Provide a support email for questions. Track the transaction in your database and NOWPayments dashboard. This first sale proves your infrastructure works. It’s not just a store—it’s a sovereign commerce stack you own and control.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your store is live, focus on scaling. Add more products by uploading files to your delivery system and updating your backend logic. Use the Complete Builder Kit’s templates to streamline this process. Monitor transaction fees—stick to TRON, BSC, or Solana networks to keep costs under $0.10. As sales grow, upgrade to the Edge Commerce Stack for faster performance and SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration. This ensures delivery emails don’t land in spam. Expand your payment options by adding more cryptocurrencies in NOWPayments. USDC, BUSD, and SOL are popular choices. Track your data in Supabase to identify trends and optimize your offerings. Scaling isn’t about adding complexity—it’s about leveraging the infrastructure you already own. Each upgrade is a step toward greater sovereignty, not dependence on platforms. Your store grows on your terms, not theirs.

To accept crypto payments in Tanzania without Stripe, use NOWPayments as your gateway. Sign up at nowpayments.io, select a cryptocurrency like USDT on TRON for low fees, and integrate the API into your store. Configure the webhook to trigger product delivery once payment confirms on-chain. Host your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for free, and use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic. Store orders in Supabase or Google Sheets, and deliver files via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This stack is sovereign—you own every component, and it operates globally without geographic restrictions.
Own your infrastructure—no subscriptions, no dependencies, lifetime access.

Ready to deploy your sovereign commerce stack? The Complete Builder Kit provides all blueprints, templates, and guides for $197. It includes instant access to GitHub repositories, NOWPayments integration tutorials, and scaling playbooks. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to purchase. This kit is your shortcut to infrastructure sovereignty—no coding required, just proven components you assemble and own.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Gather your domain name, NOWPayments account, and digital products.
2. Choose your stack: Sovereign Starter for simplicity or Edge Commerce for performance.
3. Upload products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and generate shareable links.
4. Set up NOWPayments API and configure the webhook for automatic delivery.
5. Write backend logic in Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Worker to handle payments and delivery.
6. Connect your order database: Supabase for robustness or Google Sheets for simplicity.
7. Test the pipeline: send a test payment and confirm product delivery.
8. Deploy your store to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages.
9. Monitor your first transaction in NOWPayments and your database.
10. Scale by adding products, upgrading your stack, and expanding payment options.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this infrastructure if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes templates and step-by-step guides. No coding required—just follow the instructions to assemble the components.
What cryptocurrencies should I accept for low fees?
Use USDT on TRON, BNB on BSC, or SOL on Solana. These networks process transactions for under $0.10, ensuring low costs for you and your customers.
How do I ensure delivery emails don’t land in spam?
Upgrade to the Edge Commerce Stack, which includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration. This verifies your email domain and improves deliverability.
Can I add more products after deployment?
Yes. Upload new files to your delivery system, update your backend logic, and test the flow. The infrastructure scales with your business.
What if a customer’s payment doesn’t confirm?
NOWPayments provides real-time transaction status. If payment fails, the customer won’t receive the product. Communicate this clearly in your store’s FAQ.
